title: LaunchPreparationBridgeResult
description: Control-plane-facing projection of a capsule launch-preparation decision (#581 ↔ #593). Produced by engine::launch_preparation_bridge. Carries only flat identity refs, content hashes, a stable blocker vocabulary, and the reference-only PrepareSession command — never raw secrets or observed/runtime diagnostics.

capsule_instance_key.description: Per-launch instance key derived from (profile key + revision + execution id).

execution_id.description: Launch-time execution identity. Deterministic from stable inputs; never an observed pid/container id.

requirement_graph_hash.description: Requirement-graph CONTENT hash. Must differ from requirement_graph_snapshot_hash (#588/#596).

requirement_graph_snapshot_hash.description: Requirement-graph SNAPSHOT identity (graph + profile defaults + completeness). Kept distinct from the content hash.

launch_template_key_hash.description: Key hash of the reused launch template.

selected_runner_ref.description: Control-plane reference to the selected runner. Never a pid/container/live route.

command_request_id.description: Idempotency / correlation key for the later dispatch layer.

PrepareSessionCommand.description: The reference-only PrepareSession command. A prepared plan carries ONLY this command kind — never start_session or stop_session.

materialization_plan.description: Reference to the persisted per-session materialization plan.

code.description: Stable blocker vocabulary. launch_preparation_unavailable is reserved for callers that cannot reach capsule at all.

detail.description: Non-authoritative human diagnostic. May be omitted. Never carries secrets or observed runtime facts.
